== Summary ==
The glass trophy for the Rosemount Open 2012, engraved "The Force is Strong with this One". The Players Committee billed the [[2012 US Nationals]] (8–10 June 2012, Bloomington, Minnesota) as "Nationals 2012 featuring the Rosemount Open". Organizer [[Mark Walseth]] posted the photograph a week before the event: "Here it is! Good Luck Everyone! One WEEK!"

* '''Event:''' [[2012 US Nationals]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2012-06-01
